title: Electrician Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for electrical service work — trip fee, permits, panel work, labor and parts. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. All electrical work performed per local code; permits were obtained where required.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled electrician line items: trip fee, permits, panel work, labor, parts
License # and EIN / Tax ID fields — required on client-facing invoices in most states
Permits line kept separate and non-taxable where your state allows

faqs.q: What should I include on an electrician invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list of work (trip fee, permits, labor, parts), tax, and a total due. Most states require a contractor license number on client-facing invoices.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. Download the PDF free without an email. The Word and Excel versions are free too — just leave your email so we can send the download link and occasional updates.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
